verdict.rationale: Rippling is a SaaS HR/IT/finance platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The public APIs, the Rippling CLI and the developer llms.txt are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
